assets.prompt: Regenerate the four resistance states of The Alarm as one consistent bed drawn four times, progressively levered up from the head while the foot stays on the floor; this quadrant is the rest state, flat on the floor, the duvet held and the occupant watchful. Keep the frame, posts, mattress and proportions identical across all four; vary only the angle, the duvet and the occupant. Isolated on flat chroma with no room, text, logo or watermark.
edits: Keyed the chroma field locally with a soft matte and a despill that pulls green back to what the surrounding red and blue justify.
Split the 4096x4096 sheet into four 2048x2048 quadrants.
Normalised on the timber frame rather than the whole silhouette, because the duvet and occupant legitimately change shape between states while the frame does not.
Area-averaged down onto a 900 by 900 canvas, every source pixel contributing, so a roughly threefold reduction supersamples rather than aliases.
Registered the foot-end post base to a single canvas point shared by all four states, so the bed pivots on the foot it stands on instead of drifting between drawings.
Left the drawn angle intact. The artwork carries the lift and the engine keeps only a small continuous creep, so no state was resampled by rotation.
